title: v5 tool printing message twice when used onFinish callback in result.toUIMessageStreamResponse
body: ### Description So what happening is when i add the `onFinish` callback to `toUIMessageStreamResponse` the chat starts adding the tool output twice on the Messages if we comment out the `onFinish` callback it works fine again ``` return result.toUIMessageStreamResponse({ onFinish: ({ messages }) => { console.log('onFinish', messages); }, }); ``` ## How to test - Clone https://github.com/khanakia/vercel_ai_doublemessagebug - `pnpm i` - `pnpm dev` - Open http://localhost:3000/use-chat-tools - type `contact` - Click the YES in the tool button https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e9a9fb7b-3393-4e1c-a4c6-87f4db1a2698 ### AI SDK Version ``` "@ai-sdk/openai": "2.0.0-beta.5", "@ai-sdk/provider-utils": "3.0.0-beta.2", "@ai-sdk/react": "2.0.0-beta.9", "ai": "5.0.0-beta.9", ```

linked_prs.title: fix (ui): do not send changing assistant message ids when onFinish is provided
linked_prs.body:
## Background

#7169 uncovered an issue where the onFinish callback on toUIMessageStream triggered the sending of different assistant message ids.

## Summary

Ensure no id is generated in this situation.

## Verification

Tested against next and next-openai examples.

## Related Issues

Fixes #7169
